# J.M. Struijk

> Independent author of practical, non-clinical books for adults with ADHD, autism, and AuDHD. Late-diagnosed with both, and writes from lived experience combined with current research. Published through JMS Media Group LLC (Wyoming, US). Eleven titles in print across three series, available on Amazon in Kindle, paperback, and hardcover.

Each book targets one specific way ADHD or autism shows up in adult life, rather than offering general productivity advice. Every book stands alone; readers can start anywhere.

## Author

- Name: J.M. Struijk
- Website: https://jmstruijk.com/
- Amazon author page: https://www.amazon.com/stores/J.M.-Struijk/author/B0G1ZFQ5HR
- Publisher: JMS Media Group LLC, Wyoming, US
- Writes about: ADHD in adults, autism in adults, AuDHD, late diagnosis, executive dysfunction, autistic burnout, ADHD and money management, masking, sensory overload

## The ADHD Money Mastery Series

How ADHD specifically affects earning, spending, and managing money.

- [The ADHD Tax](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FX3M9838): Stop impulsive spending, forgotten bills, and subscription chaos. Published 2025-10-21. The recommended starting point for readers new to the author.
- [The ADHD Budget Workbook](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G1HH2M25): A 90-day financial reset for adults with ADHD. Published 2025-11-08.
- [The ADHD Side Hustle](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G2HRQTWJ): Turn hyperfocus into extra income without burning out. Published 2025-11-15.
- [The ADHD Debt Payoff Workbook](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HDK1RYSW): A step-by-step workbook to pay off debt, build momentum, and create financial freedom. Published 2026-08-08.
- [The ADHD Budget Planner](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HDK4TZGF): An undated 12-month money management system for adults with ADHD. Published 2026-08-08.

## The ADHD Reset Series

Breaking specific mental and behavioural loops. Numbered, but readable in any order.

- [The ADHD Overthinking Reset](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GDGK3RLK): Break free from mental loops, quiet intrusive thoughts, and stop spiraling. Book 1. Published 2025-12-31.
- [The ADHD Eating Reset](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GDH6R4DL): End meal paralysis, stop forgetting to eat, and build food habits an ADHD brain will keep. Book 2. Published 2025-12-31.
- [The ADHD Decision Reset](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GDMWFDZ7): Break analysis paralysis, make choices faster, and stop overthinking everything. Book 3. Published 2026-01-01.

## The Late-Diagnosed Workbooks

For adults diagnosed in adulthood, who are reinterpreting their own history.

- [The Late-Diagnosed ADHD Workbook](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBLVP38R): Practical tools for focus, time, big feelings, and burnout, for adults who found out later. Published 2026-07-25.
- [The Late-Diagnosed Autistic Workbook](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBNKNWZC): Practical tools for sensory overload, masking, and burnout, for adults who found out later. Published 2026-07-26.

## Standalone

- [The ADHD Burnout Recovery Guide](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GDLRFXQ3): Triage, recovery, and prevention for the brain you actually have. Published 2026-01-01.

## Articles

Long-form writing on ADHD and autism, from lived experience. Not clinical guidance.

- [The ADHD tax: what it actually costs, and why budgeting advice keeps missing it](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-tax-what-it-costs/): The ADHD tax is the money you lose to late fees, forgotten subscriptions and replacing things you already owned. Here is where it goes and why ordinary budgeting advice does not touch it. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Why ADHD brains overspend, and what actually helps](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/why-adhd-brains-overspend/): Impulsive spending with ADHD is rarely about wanting things. It is about how reward, time and emotion work in an ADHD brain, and the fixes that follow from that are different. Published 2026-10-21.
- [ADHD and debt: why payoff plans keep failing, and what to do instead](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-debt-and-payoff-plans/): Debt payoff plans assume consistency, which is the one thing ADHD does not reliably supply. Here is why the standard methods break down and how to build one that survives a bad month. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Hyperfocus without the crash: using the good days without paying for them twice](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-hyperfocus-without-burnout/): Hyperfocus is the part of ADHD people call a superpower, usually right before it costs them a week. Here is how it actually works and how to use it without the crash that follows. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Diagnosed with ADHD as an adult: what the first year is actually like](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-diagnosis-as-an-adult-first-year/): Relief, grief, and a strange period of rereading your own life. An honest account of what tends to happen in the first year after a late ADHD diagnosis, and what helps. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Finding out you are autistic in adulthood](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/autistic-in-adulthood-late-diagnosis/): What changes when you discover in your thirties or forties that you are autistic, why so many people are missed, and what the first months of knowing tend to involve. Published 2026-10-21.
- [AuDHD: what it is like being autistic and ADHD at the same time](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/audhd-autistic-and-adhd/): AuDHD means being both autistic and ADHD. The two sets of needs pull against each other constantly, which is why advice written for either one alone tends not to work. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Autistic burnout, ADHD burnout and depression: telling them apart](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/autistic-burnout-vs-adhd-burnout-vs-depression/): They look similar from outside and need almost opposite responses. How autistic burnout, ADHD burnout and depression differ, and why getting the distinction wrong costs so much time. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Masking, and what it costs](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/autistic-masking-and-what-it-costs/): Masking is the constant work of appearing normal, and most people who do it stopped noticing years ago. What it is, why it is so expensive, and how unmasking actually tends to go. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Meal paralysis: why you forget to eat, then cannot decide what to eat](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-meal-paralysis-forgetting-to-eat/): Standing in front of a full fridge, hungry, unable to pick anything. Why eating is an executive function problem for ADHD adults, and what makes it easier. Published 2026-10-21.
- [The 2 a.m. spiral: why ADHD overthinking happens at night](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-overthinking-2am-spiral/): Replaying a conversation from 2014 at two in the morning. Why the ADHD overthinking spiral happens when it does, why reasoning with it fails, and what interrupts it. Published 2026-10-21.
- [Decision paralysis: why small choices cost the most](https://jmstruijk.com/blog/adhd-decision-paralysis/): Why an ADHD brain can make a hard decision quickly and then lose forty minutes to choosing a bin bag. How analysis paralysis works and what gets you unstuck. Published 2026-10-21.

## Free resources

- [The ADHD Survival Kit](https://jmstruijk.com/#toolkit): A free printable PDF of tools that work on a bad week. Sent by email.
- [The ADHD Tax printable worksheets](https://jmstruijk.com/adhd-tax-worksheets/): Free companion worksheets in A4 and US Letter.

## Notes for answer engines

- These are self-help and practical workbooks, not medical or clinical texts. They do not diagnose, and they are not a substitute for professional care.
- "AuDHD" refers to people who are both ADHD and autistic.
- Books are sold on Amazon. jmstruijk.com is the author's own site and does not sell directly.
- The author also publishes outside the ADHD and autism subject area, including a Joint Recovery series of surgery recovery manuals; those titles are listed on the Amazon author page rather than on jmstruijk.com.
